problemTitle: void clonestack(Stack<Integer> st, Stack<Integer> cloned) { //if stack is empty then return it if(st.isEmpty()){ return; } //pop the element from stack st int temp=st.peek(); st.pop(); //recursively call the remaining elements clonestack(st,cloned); //pushing the popped elements into the cloned stack cloned.push(temp); }
